temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan initially questions Christian's suspicion, then admits he has been hiding something: he is in some trouble and did not know how to tell Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from Christian, which has made Christian anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Jonathan confirms he was hiding something and reveals that he is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding something important and is in some kind of trouble.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious, then worried/concerned after learning Jonathan is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Jonathan and uncover the truth about what he is hiding; after the admission, to learn more about Jonathan's trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it, but he accepts Christian's offer of support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan has been hiding something important and is in some kind of trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Christian learns that Jonathan's trouble is complicated, Jonathan is reluctant to involve him, but Jonathan will accept support and resources.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in complicated trouble and has accepted Christian's help; Christian can and should support him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Jonathan and provide support/resources so they can face the trouble together.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian asks if the trouble is illegal. Jonathan says he cannot say for sure, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble is related to some kind of criminal activity; Christian feels conflicted and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Jonathan's answer suggests possible entanglement with wrong people or criminal activity, while Jonathan denies personal illegal acts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be involved with wrong people or criminal activity, but he claims he did not personally do anything illegal; the situation needs careful investigation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan and find out what is really going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed. Christian tells Jonathan he believes someone is trying to set him up and that he has leads to gather more evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be involved with wrong people or criminal activity, but he claims he is innocent and Christian is investigating discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Christian's investigation shifts his belief from uncertainty about Jonathan's involvement to believing Jonathan is innocent and is being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed by someone; Christian must clear Jonathan's name.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian discovers and tells Jonathan that the real culprit is someone both of them know and trust. Christian plans to confront this person and bring them to justice.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed; the culprit is still unidentified, and Christian is gathering evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - Christian identifies the real culprit as someone close to both him and Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both Christian and Jonathan is behind the frame-up; Jonathan is innocent, and this trusted person has betrayed them.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Betrayed, resolute, and protective of Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, ensuring Jonathan is cleared.
